Thanks Sophie — cc'ing our SE for logistics. Two quick recommendations to avoid timezone DST issues:
1) Always specify UTC in the invite body and set the calendar event timezone explicitly (Europe/Paris for Sophie, America/Los_Angeles or America/New_York for US folks).
2) Avoid scheduling across the US DST transition (March 8) because attendees who travel can get auto-shifted. If Liam is moving around Mar 8 it might be safer to target the week after.

Given those constraints, how about:
- Thu Mar 11, 15:00 UTC (16:00 CET, 07:00 PST) — still within business hours for Europe and manageable for US early risers.

I'll attach our demo runbook so Sophie and Liam know the agenda and tech pre-reqs.
